id: title:adboio:stamp no consent when consent gated tools leave the roster

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the audience eligibility and execution behavior of the guidance engine, potentially allowing or blocking tool-dependent workflows based on AI consent status.
review.reason: P1.F1.H1 adds a production check for AI consent before requiring a tool, changing the outcome of audience checks. P1.F2.H1 is a test implementation with no established relationship to P1.F1.H1, so it is unassessed. The score is based solely on P1.F1.H1.
review.uncertainty: The complete context and shared dependency between P1.F1.H1 and P1.F2.H1 are not established; P1.F2.H1 could belong to a different change group. The score does not account for P1.F2.H1. The actual impact on PostHog users depends on the broader guidance engine implementation, which is not fully demonstrated in this chunk.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains two hunks. P1.F1.H1 is a production implementation change. P1.F2.H1 is a test implementation change. No relationship or shared context is established between these two hunks. P1.F2.H1 could belong to a different PR or a different change group. P1.F1.H1 is the only hunk with sufficient context for a score. P1.F2.H1 is unassessed.

observations.behavior: Adds a check for AI consent before requiring a tool. If consent is withheld, the caller does not require the tool to be present. This changes the outcome of the audience check.
observations.posthog_connection: This could allow the guidance engine to proceed without requiring a tool when the user has not consented to AI, potentially changing the behavior of the guidance notice or the underlying tool execution.
